scenarios.name: Expand and collapse an extrusion's browser children

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with an extrusion and its underlying sketch
the extrusion branch is collapsed in the model browser
the user right-clicks the extrusion and chooses Expand All Children
the extrusion branch displays its sketch child
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user right-clicks the extrusion and chooses Collapse All Children
the extrusion branch still displays its direct sketch child
the solid remains visible in the viewport
